items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And that's what Frankie Halfbint used to advertise. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I heard of it. You know?

ctx.x: Yeah, I heard of it. You know?
Mm-hmm. And that's what Frankie Halfbint used to advertise. Yeah.

On the radio. Well, he had a good chance. We broadcast one night. And I don't know, it's just like I said at Titanes. We rehearsed before then and the man sounded good. But when we got on the air, it sounded all together different. And it seems like some people, Titans up, you know, to get those butterflies in here, you know? And they just don't produce as well as if you was playing for a dance or a live. Loose. Just like playing music note for note and playing without the music. Yeah. Well, you just can relax,…
